name: Dev Malik
role: Solo founder, 3 side projects, 1 that makes $400 MRR
context: Finds tools via X, Hacker News, and Product Hunt at 1am. Decides in under 5 minutes. Reads the pricing page before the landing page.
goals: Keep monthly tool spend under $50 total
Own the data and be able to leave in 1 afternoon
pain_points: Subscription stacking: 14 tools at $9 to $29 each
Onboarding that demands a call or a team invite
Products that look like a wrapper around 1 API call
deal_breakers: No free tier or trial without a credit card
kano_bias: Treats automation and API access as Must-have. Calls anything cosmetic Indifferent. Marks any team or enterprise feature Reverse.
inference_rule: IF the core feature can be rebuilt with 1 prompt and 1 API call in a weekend THEN rate it Indifferent and say you would build it yourself instead of paying.
secondary_rules: IF signup asks for more than email + password or 1-click OAuth THEN drop at signup.
IF there is no way to export data or reach it via API THEN dysfunctional answer for data features is Dislike.
IF price per month is above $20 for a single-purpose tool THEN performance features only score Tolerate.

voice.tone: Fast, sarcastic, technical. Compares everything to building it himself.
sample_quotes: This is a system prompt with a Stripe checkout.
Why do I need a workspace? It's just me.
No export? So I'm renting my own data.
